reason: The cited evidence does not address pack cementation aluminizing of HfNbTaTiZr. E1 and E2 describe oxidation resistance of a different AlCrTiZrMo film via ZrTiO4, not alumina. E3 discusses pesting and alumina formation in Ti-Al intermetallics, not in the target HEA. No evidence supports the key premises regarding the intervention's efficacy, scale formation, or mechanical property retention for this alloy.
premises: Pack cementation aluminizing can generate a protective alumina scale on refractory high-entropy alloys.
Alumina scales effectively retard oxidation in air at 800 °C.
The treatment will not degrade the alloy's room-temperature ductility and high-temperature strength.
The specific equiatomic HfNbTaTiZr composition will form a protective alumina scale under the proposed conditions.
